TERRA is the new Erasmus Mundus joint master in earthen architecture and construction, training engineers and architects to build and conserve with earth-based materials in a warming climate. The First Call for the 2027/2028 academic year closes on 15 January 2027 and every eligible application in this window is automatically considered for both Erasmus Mundus and Consortium scholarships.

Programme Highlights

  • New-generation Erasmus Mundus programme blending structural engineering, architecture and heritage
  • Scholarship package: participation costs fully covered plus EUR 1,400 monthly support
  • First call open to all nationalities with automatic scholarship consideration
  • Mobility across European consortium universities with hands-on construction workshops

Who Should Apply

Degrees in civil engineering, architecture or equivalent qualifications are required. Interviews follow the preselection stage, and admission notifications arrive by the end of March in the typical cycle.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships: EUR 9,000 participation cost covered plus EUR 1,400 per month for the duration of the programme.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit through the application form on the TERRA website by 15 January 2027; later calls may open for self-funded places only. Key deadline information: 15 January 2027 (First Call — Erasmus Mundus and Consortium scholarships).
